definition: The measured subset is biased: cached choices omit candidate timings, while non-first cached choices can be remeasured by the existing backend cache-read bug. These aggregates describe logged measurements, not overall backend win rates or operator performance guarantees.
One unique kernel-name training context per model/tuning/current placement, rank0 only; not runtime invocation counts and not weighted by dynamic frequency.
Fused original ATen origin labels, not necessarily standalone operators. GEMM/conv ancestry remains native ATen. by_aten_origin overlaps across fused contexts, so its counts must not be summed.
eager_validated is primary for inspection; training_only is separate. all_successful_training combines both explicitly. Numerical-warning and failed-model contexts are excluded from aggregates.
100*(Triton_us-FlyDSL_us)/Triton_us, positive saves time. Geomean uses Triton/FlyDSL timing ratios first; it is not an average of percentages. Lower microsecond timings are better.
3% ratio band: Triton/FlyDSL>1.03 is FlyDSL win, <1/1.03 is Triton win, otherwise near tie. This is a reporting threshold, not statistical significance.

At least five measured contexts across at least two models, eager-validated only, grouped separately per tuning mode. Consistent measured fusions additionally require the 10th percentile of logged FlyDSL time savings above zero. Bias warning still applies.
Kernel autotuner times are not full-step contributions. No per-model speedup is inferred by summing these kernel contexts.
